description: Least-privilege capability for the app's local windows. The Go Magic UI is served by the bundled Go backend over http://127.0.0.1:<port>, which Tauri treats as *remote* content, so this local-only capability intentionally grants the UI no access to Tauri commands. If the UI ever needs IPC from that origin, add an explicit `remote` capability instead of loosening this one. `update-check` is the hidden window that runs the launch-time version check (splash/update-check.html); it only invokes app-defined commands (`get_app_info`, `notify_update_available`, `update_check_finished`).
